title: Ethnopharmacological Evaluation of Sanjie Xiaoliu Granule in Breast Cancer with Depression
author: Liu, Tong, et al.
materials: Untargeted metabolomic profiling was performed using a UHPLC–Q Exactive Orbitrap system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, USA) equipped with a Hypersil GOLD C18 column (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.9 μm). Samples were analyzed in both positive and negative ion modes under a 0.3 mL/min gradient elution. Raw data were processed using Compound Discoverer 3.1 for peak alignment and normalization. Multivariate statistical analyses (PCA, OPLS-DA) were conducted with SIMCA 14.1, and significant metabolites were identified according to VIP > 1.0, FC > 1.5 or < 0.67, and p < 0.05. KEGG-based pathway enrichment was performed through MetaboAnalyst 5.0.

steps.title: Prepare SJXLG aqueous extract
steps.instruction: Soak the listed herbs (Codonopsis pilosula, Astragalus mongholicus, Ganoderma lucidum, Ostrea gigas, Fritillaria thunbergii, Prunella vulgaris, Angelica sinensis, Curcuma aromatica, Vitex trifolia, Vaccaria hispanica, Taraxacum mongolicum) in 4 volumes of distilled water for 30 min, decoct 30 min, filter, repeat decoction with the residue under the same conditions, combine both filtrates and concentrate under reduced pressure to a viscosity of 2.0 g mL⁻¹, then store the extract at 4 °C.

steps.title: Administer SJXLG to rats and collect serum
steps.instruction: Randomly assign 20 Sprague‑Dawley rats to SJXLG (n=10) and control (n=10) groups; gavage the SJXLG group with the clinical equivalent dose of 3.9 g kg⁻¹ daily for 7 days, give distilled water to controls; one hour after the last dose, anesthetize with 3 % sodium pentobarbital (30 mg kg⁻¹), collect blood from the abdominal aorta, centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 15 min at 4 °C, inactivate the serum, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Culture breast cancer cell lines
steps.instruction: Thaw and maintain MCF‑7 cells in high‑glucose DMEM with 10 % FBS and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin; maintain 4T1 cells in RPMI‑1640 with 10 % Gibco FBS and 1 % penicillin‑streptomycin; incubate both at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ atmosphere and use cells in logarithmic growth phase for experiments.

steps.title: Establish corticosterone‑stress model
steps.instruction: Add 200 µM corticosterone to MCF‑7 cultures and co‑incubate for 15 min to generate the breast‑cancer‑depression (BCD) cell model.

steps.title: Mito‑Tracker Green staining
steps.instruction: Seed MCF‑7 cells at 1 × 10⁵ cells well⁻¹ in 24‑well plates, culture overnight, treat with drug for 24 h, wash three times with PBS, incubate with 0.5 µM Mito‑Tracker Green for 15 min, wash three more times with PBS, and image mitochondrial morphology using a laser confocal microscope.

steps.title: JC‑1 mitochondrial membrane potential assay
steps.instruction: After 24 h drug treatment, wash MCF‑7 cells twice with PBS, add 1 mL JC‑1 working solution per well and incubate at 37 °C for 20 min, wash twice with JC‑1 buffer, capture red (590 nm) and green (530 nm) fluorescence under an inverted fluorescence microscope, and calculate the red/green intensity ratio.

steps.title: Hematoxylin & eosin staining of tumor tissue
steps.instruction: Fix tumor tissue, embed, and cut sections ~4.5 µm thick; deparaffinize and rehydrate sections, stain with hematoxylin for 3 min, rinse, counter‑stain with eosin for 5 min, mount slides, and image under a light microscope.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining for Ki‑67
steps.instruction: Deparaffinize and hydrate sections, treat with H₂O₂, incubate overnight with Ki‑67 primary antibody (1:200), then with CoraLite 488‑conjugated secondary antibody for 1 h, counterstain nuclei with DAPI, and capture fluorescence images to determine the percentage of Ki‑67‑positive cells.

steps.title: Untargeted metabolomics profiling
steps.instruction: Analyze samples on a UHPLC‑Q Exactive Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher) equipped with a Hypersil GOLD C18 column (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.9 µm) using a 0.3 mL min⁻¹ gradient in both positive and negative ion modes; process raw data with Compound Discoverer 3.1 for peak alignment and normalization; perform PCA and OPLS‑DA in SIMCA 14.1; select significant metabolites with VIP > 1.0, fold change > 1.5 or < 0.67, and p < 0.05; conduct KEGG pathway enrichment via MetaboAnalyst 5.0.

steps.title: Retrieve and analyze GSE15852 dataset
steps.instruction: Download GSE15852 from GEO, perform differential expression analysis with the limma R package, and consider genes with P < 1 as differentially expressed; obtain major depressive disorder‑related genes from GeneCards using the keyword “Major Depressive Disorder.”

steps.title: Predict SJXLG compound targets
steps.instruction: Obtain SMILES or 3D SDF structures of the 24 active SJXLG compounds from PubChem, submit them to PharmMapper, SwissTargetPrediction, and TargetNet; remove redundant targets, convert remaining targets to gene symbols via UniProt, and retain the unique target list.

steps.title: Integrate targets with DE genes
steps.instruction: Intersect SJXLG predicted targets with the differentially expressed genes from GSE15852 using R (ggplot2) to identify key genes involved in SJXLG intervention in breast‑cancer‑associated depression.

steps.title: Analyze TCGA‑BRCA RNA‑seq data
steps.instruction: Download TCGA‑BRCA RNA‑seq data, compare gene expression using unpaired Student’s t‑test for normally distributed genes and rank‑sum test for non‑normal genes; treat P < 0.05 as significant.

steps.title: Construct PPI network and enrichment
steps.instruction: Build a protein‑protein interaction network with STRING, perform GO and KEGG enrichment using clusterProfiler and org.Hs.eg.db R packages, focusing on the 19 intersecting genes.

steps.title: Lasso and Cox regression analyses
steps.instruction: Apply Lasso regression with glmnet (v4.2.1) using cross‑validation to select prognostic genes (optimal λ, maximum likelihood, C‑index); conduct univariate Cox regression for each gene; intersect Lasso‑selected and Cox‑significant genes using ggplot2.

steps.title: Multivariate Cox and survival analysis
steps.instruction: Perform multivariate Cox regression to identify SJXLG target genes linked to breast‑cancer prognosis; plot Kaplan‑Meier curves for high‑ vs. low‑risk groups with survminer and ggplot2; evaluate 1‑, 3‑, and 5‑year risk‑score performance using the timeROC R package.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of experimental data
steps.instruction: Express data as mean ± SD; use SPSS 25.0 for analysis; apply one‑way ANOVA with LSD post‑hoc for normally distributed data with equal variance, Tamhane’s T2 for unequal variance, and Kruskal‑Wallis test for non‑normal data; consider P < 0.05 statistically significant.
